name: The Wayward Tower
source:
Follow a man cursed to roam the world without ever finding a home, as the road once more leads him to a mysterious tower where a wolf-like wizard lives in peaceful solitude.

[From [url=https://team-wolf-in-a-tower.itch.io/the-wayward-tower]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随一个被诅咒的人在世界上漫游而找不到家，道路再次将他带到一座神秘的塔楼，那里有一个像狼一样的巫师安静地生活着。

[来自[url=https://team-wolf-in-a-tower.itch.io/the-wayward-tower]Itch.io[/url]]
